# BlockClimbablePropertiesComponent Class

> [!CAUTION]
> This class is still in pre-release.  Its signature may change or it may be removed in future releases.

## Extends
- [*BlockComponent*](BlockComponent.md)

Represents the climbable properties of a block with a 'minecraft:climbable' component.

## Properties

### **canClimb**
`read-only canClimb: boolean;`

Returns whether an entity can climb this block when its feet are sharing the same position as the block. Returns false when the block does not define a 'minecraft:climbable' component.

Type: *boolean*

Notes:
  - This property can throw errors when used.
    - Throws [*LocationInUnloadedChunkError*](LocationInUnloadedChunkError.md), [*LocationOutOfWorldBoundariesError*](LocationOutOfWorldBoundariesError.md)

### **canHoldPositionWhileSneaking**
`read-only canHoldPositionWhileSneaking: boolean;`

Returns whether a player on this block can stop descending and hold their position when sneaking. Returns false when the block does not define a 'minecraft:climbable' component

Type: *boolean*

Notes:
  - This property can throw errors when used.
    - Throws [*LocationInUnloadedChunkError*](LocationInUnloadedChunkError.md), [*LocationOutOfWorldBoundariesError*](LocationOutOfWorldBoundariesError.md)

## Constants

### **componentId**
`static read-only componentId = "minecraft:climbable";`

Type: *string*
